products.notes: Core CRM for sales.
Simplified edition tier that bundles built-in AI, analytics, collaboration, and security into a single purchase.
Mid-to-upper edition tier with expanded AI capacity, analytics, collaboration, and premium support.
Top edition tier, with the broadest built-in AI, analytics, collaboration, and agent capacity package.
Legacy desktop CTI adapter toolkit for integrating telephony with Salesforce; superseded by the browser-based Open CTI framework.
Large-scale event ingestion and delivery infrastructure underpinning Platform Events and Change Data Capture.
Browser-based telephony integration framework replacing CTI Toolkit. Still used by third-party CTI partners alongside partner contact center integrations.
Customer service and support platform for case management, omnichannel support, and service operations across sales, service, and digital engagement workflows.

Digital experiences and portals for customer and partner self-service. Replaced the legacy Customer Portal and Partner Portal. 'Alumni Cloud' was vertical solution branding and templates for higher education, not an official product rename. The Experience Cloud name was often confused with Lightning Experience and generic 'customer experience' terms. Partner relationship management capabilities were split out into Partner Cloud. Still uses Experience Builder as the site builder tool. Now sold as the Self-Service add-on for Service Cloud, with Service Portal licenses.

Partner relationship management platform for indirect sales channels and partner ecosystems, split out of Experience Cloud's partner portal capabilities. Enables partner onboarding, deal registration, lead distribution, co-selling, and partner performance tracking. May also be branded as Agentforce Partner Cloud.
Field service management solution for technician scheduling, work orders, dispatch, and service operations across mobile and in-field workflows.
B2C digital commerce platform for storefronts, product catalogs, checkout, and merchandising.

B2B ecommerce platform built natively on Salesforce Core (Lightning Platform). Unlike Commerce Cloud (Demandware-based), B2B Commerce uses Salesforce's standard data model and runs directly on the Einstein 1 Platform, enabling deep integration with Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and other Salesforce products. Supports complex B2B use cases including account hierarchies, negotiated pricing, contract pricing, quote-to-order, and buyer personas. Also serves as the foundation for D2C Commerce for brands wanting direct-to-consumer channels with the same core architecture.

Initially launched as B2B2C Commerce, a misnomer since it was not B2B2C as the commerce community uses the term. Direct-to-consumer ecommerce offering built on the same B2B Commerce (Lightning) platform and data model. Enables brands to launch D2C channels using Salesforce Core architecture with integrated inventory, order management, and payments. Distinct from Commerce Cloud (Demandware) - D2C Commerce is for customers who want to use the same Salesforce native data model across both B2B and D2C storefronts. Part of Salesforce's Unified Commerce strategy combining B2B Commerce, D2C Commerce, and Order Management on a single platform.
Order lifecycle management for Commerce Cloud and core CRM.

Cloud-native Point of Sale system that brings online and offline shopping experiences together. Features mobile-first mPOS, clienteling, endless aisle, and store fulfillment capabilities. Integrates natively with Commerce Cloud, Service Cloud, and other Salesforce clouds.
Messaging & Journeys (Email Studio, Mobile Studio, Journey Builder).
Premium tier of Marketing Cloud Engagement with enhanced Einstein AI features on Salesforce Core.

timeline.name: Marketing Cloud Engagement Einstein Engage Plus on Core

products.current_name: Marketing Cloud Engagement Einstein Engage Plus on Core

products.notes: B2B marketing automation (forms, scoring, grading, automation rules).
Pardot (MCAE) sales enablement for reps to send marketing-approved emails and receive real-time engagement alerts. The SalesEdge development codename still appears in code references.

Marketing performance data integration and analytics platform. Distinct from Marketing Intelligence, Salesforce's newer packaged marketing analytics offering; Salesforce positions Marketing Cloud Intelligence+ as the more advanced option for analyzing campaigns, channels, and platforms seamlessly.

Packaged marketing analytics offering embedded into Salesforce's broader marketing suite. Salesforce positions it as a more out-of-the-box option with automated data management, AI campaign summaries, segment intelligence, and embedded analytics, while Marketing Cloud Intelligence+ includes it and adds deeper cross-channel analysis and visualizations.
Real-time personalization and decisioning (web/app).
Retired on March 1, 2023 in favor of the Evergage product line and later Marketing Cloud Personalization capabilities.
Predictive web and email recommendations driven by tracked site behavior (Collect Tracking Code). Legacy igodigital collect endpoints may still appear in deployed site instrumentation.
products.current_name: Predictive Intelligence (Einstein and Analytics in Marketing Cloud Engagement)

products.notes: Data Management Platform (DMP), retired February 1, 2024.
Social publishing and listening.
Unified customer data platform across the Customer 360, used as the data layer for Agentforce agents.
Native analytics on Salesforce data. The pre-launch 'Insights' codename lives on in object names like InsightsMetadata. Marketed at Dreamforce '14 as Analytics Cloud (Wave Analytics).
Tableau analytics platform. The 2024 tagline 'Tableau, powered by Agentforce' was not an official product rename.
SaaS edition of Tableau.
Agentic analytics platform with agent-powered analytics like Tableau Agent and bundles such as Tableau+. Distinct from Tableau Desktop, Cloud, and Server.
Low-code and pro-code platform for building apps.
UI component framework. Lightning Web Components (LWC) launched in 2019 as a separate modern framework alongside Aura.
No/low-code site builder for Experience Cloud.

UI runtime layer for deploying governed agent and app experiences across multiple surfaces. The Agentforce Experience Layer (AXL) name only appeared in some early assets for the April 2026 Headless 360 announcement.
Headless Toolkit is one of the products under the AIforce (now SIforce) umbrella.
PaaS for deploying apps.
Managed Redis offering on Heroku. The rename was name-only; existing instances and CLI commands are unchanged.

Serverless functions integrated with Salesforce, powered by Heroku technology. End of Sale: Oct 31, 2023; End of Renewal: Jan 31, 2024; End of Availability: Jan 31, 2025. Heroku is the recommended migration path.
Collaboration platform.
Sales workflows surfaced natively in Slack.
Enterprise social collaboration within Salesforce.
Collaborative docs and spreadsheets integrated with Salesforce and Slack. The Salesforce Anywhere name was dropped after it confused customers.
Cadences and sales productivity tooling.
Sales forecasting and pipeline management capabilities, part of the Salesforce Forecasting umbrella brand.

Umbrella for CPQ, billing, and revenue operations across quote-to-cash workflows, invoicing, and contract lifecycle management. Launched in 2020 as a bundle of CPQ, Billing, Partner Relationship Management, and B2B Commerce, not a rename of CPQ. The 2024 rebuild is native to the platform and replaces the CPQ and Billing managed packages.
Configure, Price, Quote managed package. Never renamed; it became part of Revenue Cloud in 2020. End of sale since March 2025, with Revenue Cloud as its successor.
Invoicing, collections, and revenue recognition tooling.
Entry-level CRM edition focused on guided onboarding and AI features.
Industry clouds (Communications, Financial Services, Health, Public Sector, etc.).
Nonprofit managed package for donor management, fundraising, and program management.

Nonprofit sector solution with donor management, fundraising, and program management capabilities. This is a separate product from the Nonprofit Success Pack (NPSP) and is aimed at full nonprofit CRM and constituent operations.

Industry-specific solution for consumer packaged goods (CPG) manufacturers, distributors, and brands, with planning, trade promotion, retail execution, and category management capabilities across B2B and B2C channels.
Declarative tools for industry apps (FlexCards, OmniScripts, Data Mapper formerly DataRaptor).
OmniStudio's data transformation and extraction tool. 2024 brand style guidance lowercased some component names (e.g., Omnistudio, Flexcard, Omniscript).
Sustainability and carbon management platform for tracking environmental impact, emissions, and net zero goals.

API-led connectivity and integration platform. In 2018 Salesforce announced an umbrella called Integration Cloud; this was campaign/portfolio branding and did not rename MuleSoft or Anypoint Platform.
Enterprise gateway and governance layer for API, AI/LLM, MCP, and agent interactions across mixed gateway estates (including MuleSoft, Kong, Apigee, AWS, and Azure).
Robotic Process Automation.
Declarative automation (Flow). Originated from the Informavores acquisition (2009); the early editor was a downloadable Flow Designer.
Mapping, routing, and territory planning.
Enterprise identity and CIAM capabilities.
Admin tool for designing grounded prompts; part of Copilot/Agent tooling.
Beta product for AI-assisted enterprise search and responses across org data and connected systems. The Ask Agentforce name came from customer-facing training and presentation materials.

Live interface layer that brings Salesforce data, workflows, permissions, and security to any AI interface or agent. Grew out of the April 2026 Headless 360 announcement and was branded AIforce at the Dreamforce 2026 keynote; spans Claudeforce (Salesforce in Claude), Slackforce, and Agentforce Coworker. Benioff declared AIforce officially SIforce on October 9, 2026.
A Salesforce + Anthropic partnership - a plugin connecting Claude to Salesforce data, workflows, and sales skills.
Salesforce's marketplace for apps, components, consultants, and AI agents. Before becoming the marketplace name, AgentExchange was the agent-focused section of the AppExchange site.
Web3 and blockchain capabilities platform, broadened from an initial focus on NFTs.
Security suite (encryption, audit, event monitoring).
Business continuity add-on that provides cross-region disaster recovery for Salesforce orgs, beyond standard disaster recovery.

Contact center partnership and integration model for Service Cloud and Omni-Channel routing; complements Open CTI (still used by partner CTI). Distinct from Contact Center (formerly Agentforce Contact Center), Salesforce's native contact center.

Native contact center (CCaaS) that unifies voice, digital channels, CRM data, and AI agents in a single Salesforce system, with voice running on Hyperforce instead of depending on third-party telephony providers.
Unified agent routing and workload management across channels (cases, chats, messaging, voice). Integrates with partner contact center offerings.

Supervisory and monitoring tools for managing contact center teams and optimizing agent performance. Provides real-time visibility into agent activities, queue metrics, and service operations for hybrid service teams.

Asynchronous messaging channel embedded in web and mobile apps, with Enhanced Web Chat and Enhanced In-App Chat variants. The current name is shorter due to an ongoing syllable shortage, and older names may still appear in some places. Not the same as the legacy Chat product (which was synchronous).
Real-time, synchronous web chat channel for agents and customers. Legacy Chat is to be migrated to Enhanced Chat until Feb 2026. Not to be confused with Embedded Messaging (asynchronous messaging).
Analyzes calls/meetings for insights.
Salesforce's official mobile app. The Salesforce Classic phase reflects how the legacy app was commonly referred to after Salesforce1 launched.

Reused brand. The original Work.com was a performance management platform, and the 2020 relaunch covered COVID-era workplace operations (workplace command center, employee wellness, contact tracing, shift management). Now employee service for IT and HR teams, with a service desk, employee portal, and AI agents that resolve requests in Slack and Microsoft Teams; IT service management joined in October 2025.
Data enrichment (retired).
Custom learning and enablement content.
Salesforce's AI brand umbrella, covering AI agents and automation across the Customer 360.
Advertisement management within Marketing Cloud.
Umbrella term for the Marketing suite of products built on Salesforce Core with Data Cloud

aliases: Marketing Cloud built on the Einstein 1 Platform
Marketing Cloud built on Salesforce Core
Marketing Cloud built on Data Cloud
products.notes: Edition of the next-generation Marketing Cloud built natively on Salesforce Core with Data Cloud as the foundation, designed for modern cross-channel marketing operations and customer engagement. Sits under the Marketing Cloud umbrella.
Next-generation Marketing Cloud built natively on Salesforce Core (Einstein 1 Platform) with Data Cloud as the foundation. Advanced (currently) is the same tech as Growth, with a few added features.
Interactive, form-like experiences inside emails, part of Marketing Cloud Engagement (MCE).
Low-code integration tool for business users to connect systems and automate workflows, integrated with Salesforce Flow.

Customer 360 application that works with Data Cloud to provide personalized experiences across Salesforce clouds. Provides Personalization as a Service functionality for cross-cloud personalization. Distinct from Marketing Cloud Personalization (formerly Evergage), which focuses specifically on web/app real-time personalization.
Static code analysis tool for Salesforce development. The 'sfdx-scanner' command persisted for backward compatibility after the rebrand.
Browser-based IDE for in-org Salesforce development, supporting Apex, SOQL, and lightweight debugging directly inside supported orgs.

AI-powered IDE extension for enterprise vibe coding - using natural language to generate production-ready Salesforce applications and agents. Features Vibe Codey, an AI coding agent that acts as a pair programmer. Works with VS Code-compatible IDEs and integrates with Salesforce ALM products. Initially communicated as 'Vibe Codey' but that's the name of the AI agent within the product. One of the products that makes up AIforce (now SIforce).

Point-and-click change and release management for Salesforce, tracking work items and promoting changes through a source-control-backed pipeline as an alternative to change sets. Originally a managed package, it became a built-in platform app in Spring '26.

Autonomous AI agent that helps sales teams nurture leads at scale 24/7. Renamed to better describe the work it does nurturing existing prospects and to differentiate it from the Agentforce Lead Generation agent template. Sends personalized outreach, answers customer questions, and books meetings on behalf of sales reps. Built on Agentforce platform with low-code customization through Agentforce Builder.
End-to-end platform for clinical, medical, and commercial operations in pharma, biotech, and medtech, covering trials, HCP engagement, patient services, and medical inquiry management.
Industry-specific CRM for banking, wealth management, insurance, and financial services, with relationship management, onboarding, and client service workflows built for financial institutions.
Unified digital lending and account origination solution in Financial Services Cloud (FSC).
Industry-specific solution for automotive manufacturers, dealers, and distributors, covering vehicle sales, service, and customer engagement across the automotive lifecycle.
Industry-specific solution for telecommunications and communications service providers, covering order management, product catalog, CPQ, and customer lifecycle operations.

Industry-specific solution for K-12, higher education, and workforce programs, with student recruitment, enrollment, retention, and alumni engagement capabilities. Launched in 2023 as a new Salesforce Industries product built on person accounts; it does not share lineage with the older, community-driven Education Data Architecture (EDA).

Community-driven, open source (BSD-licensed) data architecture managed package for educational institutions, covering the student life cycle. Originally called the Higher Education Data Architecture (HEDA). Separate from, and predates, the 2023 Education Cloud product.

Industry-specific solution for energy and utility providers, with an industry data model and processes for customer service, billing inquiries, rate plans, field work, and clean energy program management.
Healthcare-focused CRM for patient engagement, care coordination, utilization management, and provider network operations.

Industry-specific solution for manufacturers that aligns sales and operations, with sales agreements, account-based forecasting, and run-rate business tracking tied to ERP and order data, plus partner and service workflows.
Industry-specific solution for media, entertainment, and advertising organizations, covering sales, campaign management, and audience monetization workflows.
Industry-specific solution for federal, state, and local government agencies, covering constituent services, grants, case management, and compliance workflows.

AI-native back-office process automation platform built on Regrello technology, for operations across industries including manufacturing, financial services, and insurance. Automates end-to-end processes using specialized AI agents, 'digital blueprints' (single-source-of-truth process definitions), and an orchestration engine spanning disconnected systems. Regrello was founded by Aman Naimat, formerly VP of Data & Engineering at Salesforce. The Agentforce Supply Chain name only appeared in Salesforce's website product menu.
